messages:
Lucas W: quick async check-in — SLO noise last night.

Lucas W: did: noticed intermittent p99 latency climb on batcher around 03:12–03:25 UTC, looked correlated with KV eviction canary.
Lucas W: action taken: restarted a couple of batcher instances which brought latency back to normal.
Lucas W: blocker: alert routing sent pages to infra instead of eng-sre primary — we need clearer ownership.

Maria H: oncall here — I got paged at 03:15, thanks for the restart. :thumbsup:
Maria H: I silenced the noisy alert and escalated to @Raj P for canary rollback guidance.

ops-bot: alert created: BatcherHigh5xxRate (severity=pg) — triggered 03:14 UTC — link: http://inc/alert/5055

Raj P: noted. the KV eviction canary used an aggressive eviction threshold; starting rollback of canary now.
Raj P: PR to soften thresholds: #2894 — needs review from @Taylor S and @Lucas W.

Taylor S: pinged. will review the PR this morning and double-check the runbook steps.
Taylor S: question: does the runbook include the `restart batcher` mitigation? I remember a different sequence.

Lucas W: runbook currently says `scale up batcher`, not restart — i'll add `restart` as a short-term mitigation and mark it manual.
Lucas W: long-term idea: add a circuit breaker in front of batcher to avoid sudden 5xx cascades.

Maria H: follow-ups: I'll draft a short post-incident note and attach the p95/p99 graphs. also request: change routing so BatcherHigh5xxRate pages eng-sre primary PD next oncall.

Raj P: agree with routing change. i'll update alert routing + canary thresholds today.

Taylor S: blocked on access to canary cluster logs (403). @ops-bot can you open a ticket with infra-sre for me?

ops-bot: ticket created: INFRA-2048 — access to canary logs (assigned to infra-sre). link: http://tickets/INFRA-2048

Maria H: action owners recap: raj -> update routing + thresholds; taylor -> review PR + update runbook; lucas -> update runbook + sketch circuit-breaker design; maria -> write post-incident note; ops-bot -> open ticket.

Lucas W: ETA: will push runbook change + short design notes by EOD PST.
Raj P: ETA for routing + threshold tweak: ~6 hours.
Taylor S: ETA PR review: 2 hours after access is resolved.

Maria H: quick ask — if you rename or change alert names, ping the PD rotation channel so everyone is aware.

Lucas W: will do.

Raj P: thanks, will ping PD channel after changes.

Taylor S: on it, carrying on with other checks.

Maria H: closing this thread for now unless anyone has blockers. :coffee:
